verdict.rationale: Airweave's evidence shows it ships its OWN MCP server so external agents can call it (host role), plus dozens of traditional API-based source connectors (Airtable, Bitbucket, etc.) and auth-provider reuse (Composio, Pipedream) — but nothing indicates Airweave itself can plug in third-party MCP servers and consume their tools as a client. This is a plausible axis for a data-integration platform, but no evidence supports it.
